title: अष्टनवतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Seeing Duhshasana's chariot hanging back near him, Drona tells him sharply to stand and fight and not flee. Satyaki wounds him badly and Drona rebuilds his array to stop the Pandava and Panchala army.
summary.kn: ತನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಹಿಂದೆ ನಿಂತ ದುಃಶಾಸನನ ರಥ ಕಂಡು ದ್ರೋಣ ಓಡದೆ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿ ಹೋರಾಡಲು ತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಗಾಯಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ದ್ರೋಣ ಪಾಂಡವ-ಪಾಂಚಾಲ ಸೈನ್ಯ ತಡೆಯಲು ವ್ಯೂಹವನ್ನು ಮರುಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अपने निकट पीछे खड़ा दुःशासन का रथ देखकर द्रोण उसे तीखेपन से कहते हैं कि भागे नहीं, डटकर लड़े। सात्यकि उसे गहरा घायल करता है और द्रोण पाण्डव-पाञ्चाल सेना को रोकने के लिए व्यूह फिर सजाते हैं।
summary.te: తన సమీపంలో వెనుకబడిన దుశ్శాసనుని రథాన్ని చూసి ద్రోణుడు పారిపోకుండా స్థిరంగా పోరాడమని పదునుగా చెబుతాడు. సాత్యకి అతన్ని తీవ్రంగా గాయపరుస్తాడు; ద్రోణుడు పాండవ పాంచాల సేనను ఆపడానికి వ్యూహాన్ని తిరిగి అమరుస్తాడు.
summary.ta: தன் அருகே பின்தங்கிய துச்சாசனனின் தேரைக் கண்ட த்ரோணர் ஓடாமல் உறுதியாகப் போரிடச் சொல்லிக் கடிந்துகொள்கிறார். சாத்யகி அவனைக் கடுமையாகக் காயப்படுத்த, த்ரோணர் பாண்டவ பாஞ்சாலப் படையைத் தடுக்க வியூகத்தை மீண்டும் அமைக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: തനിക്കടുത്ത് ദുശ്ശാസനന്റെ രഥം പിന്നിൽ നിൽക്കുന്നത് കണ്ട ദ്രോണർ, നിന്ന് പൊരുതണം ഓടിപ്പോകരുതെന്ന് കർശനമായി പറയുന്നു. സാത്യകി അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ഗുരുതരമായി മുറിവേൽപ്പിക്കുന്നു; പാണ്ഡവ പാഞ്ചാല സേനയെ തടയാൻ ദ്രോണർ തന്റെ വ്യൂഹം പുനഃക്രമീകരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.98; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
दुःशासनरथं दृष्ट्वा समीपे पर्यवस्थितम् ।
भारद्वाजस्ततो वाक्यं दुःशासनमथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Duhshasana's chariot standing near, Bharadvaja's son Drona then spoke to Duhshasana.

verses.text:
दुःशासन रथाः सर्वे कस्मादेते प्रविद्रुताः ।
कच्चित्क्षेमं तु नृपतेः कच्चिज्जीवति सैन्धवः ॥

meaning.en: "Duhshasana, why have all these chariots fled? Is the king well? Is Saindhava alive?

verses.text:
राजपुत्रो भवानत्र राजभ्राता महारथः ।
किमर्थं द्रवसे युद्धे यौवराज्यमवाप्य हि ॥

meaning.en: You are a prince here, the king's brother and a great chariot-warrior; why do you run in battle, having received the rank of heir apparent?

verses.text:
स्वयं वैरं महत्कृत्वा पाञ्चालैः पाण्डवैः सह ।
एकं सात्यकिमासाद्य कथं भीतोऽसि संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Having yourself made great enmity with the Panchalas and the Pandavas, how is it you are afraid in battle of Satyaki alone?

verses.text:
न जानीषे पुरा त्वं तु गृह्णन्नक्षान्दुरोदरे ।
शरा ह्येते भविष्यन्ति दारुणाशीविषोपमाः ॥

meaning.en: You did not know it then, when you took up the dice in the gambling hall: these dice will become arrows like fierce venomous snakes.

verses.text:
अप्रियाणां च वचनं पाण्डवेषु विशेषतः ।
द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशस्त्वन्मूलो ह्यभवत्पुरा ॥

meaning.en: Your unkind words, especially against the Pandavas, and Draupadi's torment, were all rooted in you in the past.

verses.text:
क्व ते मानश्च दर्पश्च क्व च तद्वीर गर्जितम् ।
आशीविषसमान्पार्थान्कोपयित्वा क्व यास्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Where is your pride and your arrogance, hero? Where is that roaring? Having angered the Parthas, who are like venomous snakes, where will you go?

verses.text:
शोच्येयं भारती सेना राजा चैव सुयोधनः ।
यस्य त्वं कर्कशो भ्राता पलायनपरायणः ॥

meaning.en: This Bharata army is to be pitied, and King Suyodhana, whose brother you are, harsh yet intent on flight.

verses.text:
ननु नाम त्वया वीर दीर्यमाणा भयार्दिता ।
स्वबाहुबलमास्थाय रक्षितव्या ह्यनीकिनी ।
स त्वमद्य रणं त्यक्त्वा भीतो हर्षयसे परान् ॥

meaning.en: Surely, hero, the army, torn and terrified, should have been protected by you, relying on your own arm's strength. Yet today you leave the fight and, in your fear, cheer your enemies.

verses.text:
विद्रुते त्वयि सैन्यस्य नायके शत्रुसूदन ।
कोऽन्यः स्थास्यति संग्रामे भीतो भीते व्यपाश्रये ॥

meaning.en: When you, the leader of the army, flee, slayer of foes, what other frightened man will stand in battle, taking refuge in one frightened?

verses.text:
एकेन सात्वतेनाद्य युध्यमानस्य चानघ ।
पलायने तव मतिः संग्रामाद्धि प्रवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Sinless one, while you fight a single Satvata, your mind turns to flight from the battle.

verses.text:
यदा गाण्डीवधन्वानं भीमसेनं च कौरव ।
यमौ च युधि द्रष्टासि तदा त्वं किं करिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: When you see in battle the wielder of Gandiva, Bhimasena and the twins, Kaurava, what will you do then?

verses.text:
युधि फल्गुनबाणानां सूर्याग्निसमतेजसाम् ।
न तुल्याः सात्यकिशरा येषां भीतः पलायसे ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki's arrows are not equal to Phalguna's arrows, which have the splendor of sun and fire, and yet you flee in fear of them.

verses.text:
यदि तावत्कृता बुद्धिः पलायनपरायणा ।
पृथिवी धर्मराजस्य शमेनैव प्रदीयताम् ॥

meaning.en: If you have set your mind on flight, then let the earth be given to the Dharma king in peace.

verses.text:
यावत्फल्गुननाराचा निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभाः ।
नाविशन्ति शरीरं ते तावत्संशाम्य पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: Make peace with the Pandavas before Phalguna's iron arrows, like snakes shedding their skins, enter your body.

verses.text:
यावत्ते पृथिवीं पार्था हत्वा भ्रातृशतं रणे ।
नाक्षिपन्ति महात्मानस्तावत्संशाम्य पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: Make peace with the Pandavas before the great-souled Parthas kill your hundred brothers in battle and take the earth from you.

verses.text:
यावन्न क्रुध्यते राजा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
कृष्णश्च समरश्लाघी तावत्संशाम्य पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: Make peace with the Pandavas before King Yudhishthira, son of Dharma, and Krishna, who loves battle, grow angry.

verses.text:
यावद्भीमो महाबाहुर्विगाह्य महतीं चमूम् ।
सोदरांस्ते न मृद्नाति तावत्संशाम्य पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: Make peace with the Pandavas before the mighty-armed Bhima, plunging into the great army, crushes your brothers.

verses.text:
पूर्वमुक्तश्च ते भ्राता भीष्मेण स सुयोधनः ।
अजेयाः पाण्डवाः संख्ये सौम्य संशाम्य पाण्डवैः ।
न च तत्कृतवान्मन्दस्तव भ्राता सुयोधनः ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma told your brother Suyodhana long ago: 'The Pandavas cannot be conquered in battle, my dear; make peace with the Pandavas.' But your foolish brother Suyodhana did not do it.

verses.text:
स युद्धे धृतिमास्थाय यत्तो युध्यस्व पाण्डवैः ।
गच्छ तूर्णं रथेनैव तत्र तिष्ठति सात्यकिः ॥

meaning.en: So now, taking courage, fight the Pandavas with determination. Go quickly in your chariot to where Satyaki stands.

verses.text:
त्वया हीनं बलं ह्येतद्विद्रविष्यति भारत ।
आत्मार्थं योधय रणे सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम् ॥

meaning.en: This army, deprived of you, will flee, Bharata. Fight Satyaki, whose valor is true, in battle, for your own sake."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तव सुतो नाब्रवीत्किंचिदप्यसौ ।
श्रुतं चाश्रुतवत्कृत्वा प्रायाद्येन स सात्यकिः ॥

meaning.en: So addressed, your son said nothing at all. Acting as if he had not heard, he went where Satyaki was.

verses.text:
सैन्येन महता युक्तो म्लेच्छानामनिवर्तिनाम् ।
आसाद्य च रणे यत्तो युयुधानमयोधयत् ॥

meaning.en: With a great army of mlecchas who never turn back, he approached him in battle and fought Yuyudhana with determination.

verses.text:
द्रोणोऽपि रथिनां श्रेष्ठः पाञ्चालान्पाण्डवांस्तथा ।
अभ्यद्रवत संक्रुद्धो जवमास्थाय मध्यमम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona too, best of charioteers, in anger charged at the Panchalas and the Pandavas at a middle speed.

verses.text:
प्रविश्य च रणे द्रोणः पाञ्चालानां वरूथिनीम् ।
द्रावयामास योधान्वै शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Having entered the Panchala army in battle, Drona routed warriors by the hundreds and thousands.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणो महाराज नाम विश्राव्य संयुगे ।
पाण्डुपाञ्चालमत्स्यानां प्रचक्रे कदनं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O great king, announcing his name in the battle, Drona wrought great carnage among the Pandavas, Panchalas and Matsyas.

verses.text:
तं जयन्तमनीकानि भारद्वाजं ततस्ततः ।
पाञ्चालपुत्रो द्युतिमान्वीरकेतुः समभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: As Bharadvaja's son went on conquering armies here and there, the Panchala prince, the radiant Viraketu, came against him.

verses.text:
स द्रोणं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ।
ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध सारथिं चास्य सप्तभिः ॥

meaning.en: Having struck Drona with five straight-jointed arrows, he struck his banner with one and his charioteer with seven.

verses.text:
तत्राद्भुतं महाराज दृष्टवानस्मि संयुगे ।
यद्द्रोणो रभसं युद्धे पाञ्चाल्यं नाभ्यवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: There, O great king, I saw a marvel in the battle: that Drona, impetuous in the fight, did not at once turn on the Panchala.

verses.text:
संनिरुद्धं रणे द्रोणं पाञ्चाला वीक्ष्य मारिष ।
आवव्रुः सर्वतो राजन्धर्मपुत्रजयैषिणः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Drona hemmed in during the battle, the Panchalas, my lord, surrounded him on every side, wishing victory for the Dharma king's son.

verses.text:
ते शरैरग्निसंकाशैस्तोमरैश्च महाधनैः ।
शस्त्रैश्च विविधै राजन्द्रोणमेकमवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: With fiery arrows, with costly spears and with various weapons, O king, they showered Drona alone.

verses.text:
निहत्य तान्बाणगणान्द्रोणो राजन्समन्ततः ।
महाजलधरान्व्योम्नि मातरिश्वा विवानिव ॥

meaning.en: Drona, O king, destroyed those masses of arrows on every side, as the wind scatters great rain clouds in the sky.

verses.text:
ततः शरं महाघोरं सूर्यपावकसंनिभम् ।
संदधे परवीरघ्नो वीरकेतुरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then the slayer of enemy heroes fitted a terrible arrow, bright as sun and fire, against Viraketu's chariot.

verses.text:
स भित्त्वा तु शरो राजन्पाञ्चाल्यं कुलनन्दनम् ।
अभ्यगाद्धरणीं तूर्णं लोहितार्द्रो ज्वलन्निव ॥

meaning.en: That arrow, having pierced the Panchala, the delight of his family, went quickly into the earth, wet with blood and as though blazing.

verses.text:
ततोऽपतद्रथात्तूर्णं पाञ्चाल्यः कुलनन्दनः ।
पर्वताग्रादिव महांश्चम्पको वायुपीडितः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Panchala, the delight of his family, quickly fell from his chariot, like a great champaka tree on a mountain top struck by the wind.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्हते महेष्वासे राजपुत्रे महाबले ।
पाञ्चालास्त्वरिता द्रोणं समन्तात्पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: When that mighty bowman, that mighty prince, was killed, the Panchalas quickly surrounded Drona on every side.

verses.text:
चित्रकेतुः सुधन्वा च चित्रवर्मा च भारत ।
तथा चित्ररथश्चैव भ्रातृव्यसनकर्षिताः ॥

meaning.en: Chitraketu, Sudhanva, Chitravarman and Chitraratha, Bharata, drawn on by grief for their brother,

verses.text:
अभ्यद्रवन्त सहिता भारद्वाजं युयुत्सवः ।
मुञ्चन्तः शरवर्षाणि तपान्ते जलदा इव ॥

meaning.en: Together rushed at Bharadvaja's son, eager to fight, loosing showers of arrows like clouds at the end of summer.

verses.text:
स वध्यमानो बहुधा राजपुत्रैर्महारथैः ।
व्यश्वसूतरथांश्चक्रे कुमारान्कुपितो रणे ॥

meaning.en: Struck in many ways by the princes, great chariot-warriors, he in anger made those youths horseless, charioteerless and chariotless in the battle.

verses.text:
तथापरैः सुनिशितैर्भल्लैस्तेषां महायशाः ।
पुष्पाणीव विचिन्वन्हि सोत्तमाङ्गान्यपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: With other very sharp broad-headed arrows that man of great fame cut off their heads, as though plucking flowers.

verses.text:
ते रथेभ्यो हताः पेतुः क्षितौ राजन्सुवर्चसः ।
देवासुरे पुरा युद्धे यथा दैतेयदानवाः ॥

meaning.en: Killed, those radiant ones fell from their chariots to the earth, O king, like the Daityas and Danavas in the old war of gods and asuras.

verses.text:
तान्निहत्य रणे राजन्भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ।
कार्मुकं भ्रामयामास हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम् ॥

meaning.en: Having slain them in battle, the mighty Bharadvaja's son whirled his gold-backed bow, hard to approach.

verses.text:
पाञ्चालान्निहतान्दृष्ट्वा देवकल्पान्महारथान् ।
धृष्टद्युम्नो भृशं क्रुद्धो नेत्राभ्यां पातयञ्जलम् ।
अभ्यवर्तत संग्रामे क्रुद्धो द्रोणरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Panchalas killed, those great chariot-warriors like gods, Dhrishtadyumna, greatly enraged, tears falling from his eyes, advanced toward Drona's chariot in the battle.

verses.text:
ततो हा हेति सहसा नादः समभवन्नृप ।
पाञ्चाल्येन रणे दृष्ट्वा द्रोणमावारितं शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, a sudden cry of "Alas, alas!" went up as people saw Drona covered with arrows by the Panchala in the battle.

verses.text:
संछाद्यमानो बहुधा पार्षतेन महात्मना ।
न विव्यथे ततो द्रोणः स्मयन्नेवान्वयुध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Though covered in many ways by the great-souled Prishata's son, Drona was not troubled but fought on, smiling.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणं महाराज पाञ्चाल्यः क्रोधमूर्छितः ।
आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो नवत्या नतपर्वणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O great king, the Panchala, faint with fury, struck Drona in the chest with ninety straight-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
स गाढविद्धो बलिना भारद्वाजो महायशाः ।
निषसाद रथोपस्थे कश्मलं च जगाम ह ॥

meaning.en: Deeply pierced by the strong one, the greatly renowned Bharadvaja's son sat down on the seat of his chariot and fell into a swoon.

verses.text:
तं वै तथागतं दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नः पराक्रमी ।
समुत्सृज्य धनुस्तूर्णमसिं जग्राह वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him so, the valiant and mighty Dhrishtadyumna quickly threw down his bow and took up a sword.

verses.text:
अवप्लुत्य रथाच्चापि त्वरितः स महारथः ।
आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं भारद्वाजस्य मारिष ।
हर्तुमैच्छच्छिरः कायात्क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ॥

meaning.en: Quickly leaping from his chariot, that great chariot-warrior swiftly climbed onto Bharadvaja's son's chariot, my lord, his eyes red with fury, wishing to cut the head from his body.

verses.text:
प्रत्याश्वस्तस्ततो द्रोणो धनुर्गृह्य महाबलः ।
शरैर्वैतस्तिकै राजन्नित्यमासन्नयोधिभिः ।
योधयामास समरे धृष्टद्युम्नं महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona, recovering, took up his bow, mighty as he was, and fought the great chariot-warrior Dhrishtadyumna with vaitastika arrows, which are always used in close fighting.

verses.text:
ते हि वैतस्तिका नाम शरा आसन्नयोधिनः ।
द्रोणस्य विदिता राजन्धृष्टद्युम्नमवाक्षिपन् ॥

meaning.en: Those arrows called vaitastika, used by those who fight at close quarters, as Drona knew, he sent against Dhrishtadyumna, O king.

verses.text:
स वध्यमानो बहुभिः सायकैस्तैर्महाबलः ।
अवप्लुत्य रथात्तूर्णं भग्नवेगः पराक्रमी ॥

meaning.en: Struck by many of those arrows, the strong and valiant one, his force broken, quickly leapt down from the chariot.

verses.text:
आरुह्य स्वरथं वीरः प्रगृह्य च महद्धनुः ।
विव्याध समरे द्रोणं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Mounting his own chariot, the hero, taking up a great bow, struck Drona in the battle, the great chariot-warrior Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.text:
तदद्भुतं तयोर्युद्धं भूतसंघा ह्यपूजयन् ।
क्षत्रियाश्च महाराज ये चान्ये तत्र सैनिकाः ॥

meaning.en: Hosts of beings praised that marvelous fight between the two, as did the kshatriyas, O great king, and the other soldiers there.

verses.text:
अवश्यं समरे द्रोणो धृष्टद्युम्नेन संगतः ।
वशमेष्यति नो राज्ञः पाञ्चाला इति चुक्रुशुः ॥

meaning.en: "Surely Drona, having met Dhrishtadyumna in battle, will come into the power of our king; the Panchalas," they cried.

verses.text:
द्रोणस्तु त्वरितो युद्धे धृष्टद्युम्नस्य सारथेः ।
शिरः प्रच्यावयामास फलं पक्वं तरोरिव ।
ततस्ते प्रद्रुता वाहा राजंस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: But Drona, in haste, cut off in the battle the head of Dhrishtadyumna's charioteer like a ripe fruit from a tree, and then that great-souled one's horses bolted.

verses.text:
तेषु प्रद्रवमाणेषु पाञ्चालान्सृञ्जयांस्तथा ।
व्यद्रावयद्रणे द्रोणस्तत्र तत्र पराक्रमी ॥

meaning.en: As they ran, Drona valiantly routed the Panchalas and Srinjayas here and there in the battle.

verses.text:
विजित्य पाण्डुपाञ्चालान्भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ।
स्वं व्यूहं पुनरास्थाय स्थिरोऽभवदरिंदमः ।
न चैनं पाण्डवा युद्धे जेतुमुत्सहिरे प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Having defeated the Pandavas and Panchalas, the mighty Bharadvaja's son, tamer of foes, took up his own formation again and stood steady; and the Pandavas, O lord, could not beat him in the battle.
